newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toa Steel sharply down on expected larger losses.
newsitem.headline: Toa Steel sharply down on expected larger losses.

text.p: Shares of Toa Steel Co Ltd were sharply down on Thursday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange after the company announced a bigger-than-expected loss for the last business year, traders said.
Toa Steel's shares stood at 270 yen at midday, down 15 yen, becoming the third biggest percentage loser on the first section of the exchange.
Toa announced on Wednesday an estimated loss of 17.2 billion yen for the year ending March 1997, from its earlier forecast of a loss of 11 billion yen announced earlier.
Toa Steel's loss for 1995/96 was 6.27 billion yen.
"Current loss and net loss are both estimated in the red for three consecutive terms, and the range of losses are greater than we expected," a trader at a second-tier brokerage said.
